# 4U Repair & Services LLC

> Family-run appliance repair serving Greater New Orleans, Louisiana (also listed on Google as "4U Repair & Services LLC"). Refrigerators, washers, dryers, ovens, ranges, dishwashers, freezers and ice makers. Fast same/next-day service, honest upfront pricing. Named in honor of Anthony ("Ant"). Part of the TN Appliance Exchange family (technician-led, family-owned since 2012).

Owner-technician: Andre Pivacek. Phone: (504) 909-9413. Service area: New Orleans, Metairie, Kenner, Gretna, Marrero, Harvey, Westwego, Chalmette, Terrytown, Algiers, LaPlace and the North Shore (Slidell, Mandeville, Covington), plus Houma and Baton Rouge via the wider network.

## Services
- [Refrigerator & Freezer Repair](https://4urepairs.com/refrigerator-repair.html): A warm fridge is an emergency — hundreds of dollars of food on the line. 4U gets to New Orleans refrigerators fast and fixes the real cause, not just the symptom.
- [Washing Machine Repair](https://4urepairs.com/washer-repair.html): Top-load or front-load, HE or old-school — if your washer won't spin, won't drain, leaks, or walks across the laundry room, 4U gets it washing right again.
- [Dryer Repair](https://4urepairs.com/dryer-repair.html): No heat, taking three cycles to dry, or making a racket? 4U fixes electric and gas dryers so your clothes come out dry in one run — and your vent stays safe.
- [Oven, Range & Cooktop Repair](https://4urepairs.com/oven-repair.html): Gas or electric — when the oven won't heat, bakes uneven, throws a fault code, or a burner dies, 4U gets dinner back on the table.
- [Dishwasher Repair](https://4urepairs.com/dishwasher-repair.html): Not draining, not cleaning, or leaking onto your floor? 4U gets your dishwasher running clean and quiet without you buying a new one.
